title: CHALKBONE COAST — fossils, salt, stranded timber and brine
status: draft design resource only; not GEN recipe, native snapshot, Godot map or accepted importer

coordinate_contract.write_priority: ordered last-write-wins, scene terrain then translated modules
coordinate_contract.holes: unwritten cells do not clear existing terrain; explicit Empty 0 pass or clear region before paint
coordinate_contract.variants: literal material-ID substitution only; a dry-pan replacement 24 -> 0 is an explicit Empty write
coordinate_contract.rotation: not asserted; modules authored in one orientation; no automatic transform or mirror without rechecking joints

style_guide.theme: An eroded fossil coast after salt-winds, without industrial or neon instruments
style_guide.secondary: RockSaltBlock 106, Slate 49 and BasaltColumns 100 for age and shadow
style_guide.accents: Brine 24 turquoise, Driftwood 88 grey, VerdigrisCopper 54 as very rare old marker; no glow
style_guide.composition: The Ossuary Tide: torn inland mantle, discontinuous fossil crown, dark-solid stratigraphic crypt and eroded lower salt littoral connected by dry chalk shelves.
style_guide.ratio: roughly 70% pale dry cliff, 20% dark cavity/strata, <=10% live material in mixed areas
style_guide.geometry: tile-like orthogonal splines approximated with rectangles; no true sloped normals, physics surfaces remain cell-defined
style_guide.placement: ground contact; no unsupported full-body physics claims; keep entrances empty and avoid crushing player clearance

features.title: Wave-cut chalk shelf
features.role: Layered coast terrace, undercut and tide-bored notches

variants.note: Storm-dark compact sediment instead of bright chalk

placement_rules: Align the 96-cell floor line to the ground edge; do not infer eroding motion from a static shelf.
Keep the overhang clear of active liquid and player collision until tested.

features.title: Buried ammonite relief
features.role: Ancient spiral fossil embedded in pale chalk cut-bank
placement_rules: Relief reads from 1–3× cell scale; avoid other strong spirals within 180 cells.
This is fixed geometry, not a creature, pressure shell or dynamic object.

features.title: Saltcomb windward ridge
features.role: Saw-toothed crystal-white saltland contour with pink crust
placement_rules: Place between low shoreline shelves; preserve at least 16 open cells above tall crest.
All crystal shapes are fixed RockSaltBlock/ChalkBlock; not falling Salt powder.

features.title: Triple tide stelae
features.role: Three unequal standing markers with notched high-water lines
placement_rules: Leave 8 cells clear above central stele; no horizontal reflection or mirror assumption.
Brass/signal lighting is deliberately absent: these are old natural tide marks.

features.title: Nacre arch cave
features.role: Pale layered hollow arch framing a genuine dark empty entrance
placement_rules: The open space x28..67,y29..53 requires explicit host clearing, not implied erasure.
Arch pixels are fixed solids; passage collision geometry must be checked against player size.

features.title: Stormwood arbour
features.role: Weathered fallen timber bowed over bleached stone; combustible fixed silhouette

variants.note: All timber becomes inert stone, safer for simulation
Chalk cast of a lost tree; inert

placement_rules: Default includes Driftwood 88 and MossWall 97, both Combustible kernel, so do NOT label inert safe static.
Do not position adjacent to Fire, Lava or hot fixtures without source-locked burn tests.

features.title: Open cyan brine pan
features.role: Shallow brine lens held by stone sill, with shore crust and tide markers

variants.note: Empty basin with static perimeter; explicit Empty writes
Inert chalk-fill graphic; no brine transport

placement_rules: Default Brine 24 is a movable CellularYield liquid, not Water FreeMass; open surface can slosh/evaporate or react under current rules.
This module has no true sky/pressure containment; test leakage, contact products, finite material and tick-cost before use.

features.title: Evaporite spill fan
features.role: Salt powder cascade spilling from rock tooth into lower catch shelf

variants.note: All cascade cells fixed rock salt; inert static-scenery alternative
Fixed chalk fan, no movable salt

placement_rules: Default Salt 23 is a movable powder; perched deposits will fall and may spread beyond decorative footprint.
Allow a clear lower catch path; validate powder mass and settlement before a gameplay scene.

scene.title: The Ossuary Tide — fractured fossil-bone vault and dry littoral
scene.classification: dry static scene; original active standalone modules and variants retained
composition_rules: Asymmetric chalk headland and broken upper shelf frame a double sea-creature fossil arch with intentionally missing crown spans.
Dark basalt-filled fossil crypt is a solid artistic recess, not a navigable or cleared cave; open sky between costae is unwritten.
Retain eight original source-grounded module positions; flagship selects fossilised, stone-pan and petrified fixed substitutions for the timber, Brine and Salt sources.
Additional kernel-none scene geometry is clipped away from original module AABBs to preserve motif negative spaces.
No native or Godot render, Water/Brine/Salt physics, contact/collision clearance, performance or reference-gallery acceptance is asserted.

limits: No native/Godot runtime simulation, Rapier collision, or shader capture was executed in design authoring.
Shadow flat RGBA preview is not native simulation or production shader output.
Brine is CellularYield, not FreeMass Water; Salt is a moving powder.
Wood and MossWall may combust or change at adjacent fire/heat contacts.
Open cave is just omitted cells in proposed rectangles; existing destination terrain must be cleared before deployment.
Static marks do not supply structural breakage/ejection, real buoyancy, heat, or rope mechanics.
